project: ta_in: TradingAgents v0.7.0 rebuild for NSE stocks
rules: Work on features in list order; skip none.
Only the 'passes' field may be changed by an agent, and only after verify passes.
Never edit titles, acceptance criteria, requirements or dependencies; ask the human instead.
A feature passes only when its test file exists, covers every acceptance criterion, and verify is green.

defaults_pending_decision.fixture_set: placeholder tickers and dates until chosen

features.title: Repo skeleton with harness: pyproject, src layout, ruff, mypy, pytest, verify and init scripts, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, rules
acceptance: verify passes locally on Windows and in GitHub Actions
CLAUDE.md states how to run checks and the point-in-time rule

features.title: Settings from .env with Pydantic: provider, quick and deep models, debate rounds, risk rounds, temperature, budget
acceptance: Invalid or missing settings fail at start-up with a clear message
API keys never appear in logs or traces

features.title: LLM client wrapper over the Anthropic Messages API with retry, backoff, token and cost logging, and a budget stop
acceptance: Mocked transient error then success is retried with backoff
A budget breach raises BudgetExceeded
Every call records tokens and cost

features.title: Run trace: one JSONL file per run with agent, prompt, response, tool calls, tokens, cost and latency, plus a summary script
acceptance: Each run writes exactly one trace file
trace-summary <run> prints cost and time per agent

features.title: Response cache with record and replay modes, keyed by a hash of model, system prompt, messages, tools and parameters
acceptance: Replay mode makes zero network calls
A replayed run produces byte-identical output to the recorded run

features.title: Shared decision models: five-tier rating enum copied from TradingAgents v0.7.0, plus Decision and related Pydantic types
acceptance: Rating labels match the TradingAgents v0.7.0 code, with the source file noted in a comment
All agents import these types

features.title: DataProvider interface where every method takes as_of, plus a guard raising PointInTimeError on any later-dated record
acceptance: A later-dated record passed through the guard raises PointInTimeError

features.title: Daily OHLCV for .NS tickers via yfinance up to as_of, cached locally
acceptance: No bar after as_of is ever returned
Market holidays and missing days are handled
A second call is served from the cache

features.title: Company identity (name, sector, exchange) resolved from the ticker and cached
acceptance: The same ticker always gives the same identity
An unknown ticker fails before any agent runs

features.title: Indicators from prices: RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR, SMA, EMA, VWMA
acceptance: Unit tests match hand-calculated values on a small fixed series

features.title: Dated company and market news up to as_of, deduplicated, as typed NewsItem (title, source, published time, URL, summary)
acceptance: Items dated after as_of are dropped and logged
Duplicates are removed
Empty results return an explicit empty list

features.title: Fundamentals from yfinance for current-date runs; a typed Withheld result with the reason for past dates
acceptance: A past-dated call returns Withheld, never statements
A current-date call returns income statement, balance sheet and cash flow

features.title: Verified price snapshot (last close, 52-week high and low, recent returns) for grounding
acceptance: Snapshot values match the price series exactly
Agents receive the snapshot in their context

features.title: Fixture set file (tickers and dates) and a freeze-fixtures command that saves all data snapshots to the repo
acceptance: Snapshots exist for every fixture cell
Tests load only from snapshots and pass with the network off

features.title: TradingAgents v0.7.0 baseline in its own virtual environment, run twice per fixture cell with the same two models
acceptance: Decisions for every cell and both runs are stored as JSON
The run-to-run agreement band is computed and recorded

features.title: Typed AgentState in Pydantic: identity, snapshot, each analyst report, debate histories, plan, proposal, risk history, decision
acceptance: Each agent can only write its own fields
State serialises to JSON and back without loss

features.title: Generic agent loop: call Claude with tools, run tool calls, continue on tool_use, stop on end_turn, step limit as a safety net
acceptance: A scripted fake model covers multi-step tool use
A tool error is returned to the model as a structured error
Hitting the step limit stops cleanly

features.title: Market analyst with price and indicator tools, choosing up to 8 indicators and writing a report
acceptance: Produces a report for every fixture cell
Every price figure in the report matches the snapshot

features.title: Run selected analysts in parallel; a failed analyst records an explicit gap
acceptance: Analysts run concurrently
--analysts market,news runs only those two
A forced failure leaves a visible gap, not a crash

features.title: Insufficient-data rule: analysts flag thin evidence instead of analysing it
acceptance: With fewer than the configured minimum of news items, the report carries an insufficient_data flag

features.title: News analyst covering company and macro news
acceptance: The report cites only items dated on or before as_of, each with its source

features.title: Fundamentals analyst using statements, or stating clearly that fundamentals were withheld
acceptance: Past-dated cells say withheld and make no fundamental claims

features.title: Analyst evaluation: hand-score 10 reports on a rubric, then an automated rubric scorer compared with TradingAgents reports
acceptance: Hand and automated scores are recorded side by side
The automated scorer's agreement with hand scores is reported

features.title: Bull and bear researchers read the analyst reports and take turns for the configured number of rounds
acceptance: Each turn answers the other side's last argument
Full debate history is stored in state
The quick-tier model is used

features.title: Structured output through tool use with a JSON schema, validated, retried once with the error message, then a loud failure
acceptance: A malformed fake response triggers exactly one retry
A second failure raises, with the raw output saved to the trace

features.title: Research manager on the deep tier judges the debate and returns a structured InvestmentPlan
acceptance: Output validates against the schema on every fixture cell
The plan quotes at least one point from each side

features.title: Debate rounds configurable from 0 to 3, with deterministic replay
acceptance: 0, 1 and 2 rounds each run end to end
Replayed runs match recorded runs exactly

features.title: Trader turns the investment plan into a structured TradeProposal: action, rating, rationale, evidence references
acceptance: Every proposal validates
Each evidence reference points to a real field in state

features.title: Aggressive, neutral and conservative risk analysts debate the proposal for the configured number of rounds
acceptance: Each analyst responds to the other two
History is stored in state
0 and 1 rounds both work

features.title: Portfolio manager on the deep tier returns the final Decision on the five-tier scale
acceptance: The decision validates on every fixture cell
Its rationale cites the risk discussion

features.title: propagate(ticker, date) runs the whole pipeline and returns state and decision
acceptance: One fixture cell runs end to end in replay mode inside CI
Total cost and time are reported

features.title: Command line: run --ticker --date --analysts --rounds, plus --replay
acceptance: Runs a fixture cell from the shell
Missing or invalid flags give a clear error
--replay makes no network calls

features.title: Save each agent's report as Markdown and the final decision as JSON under results/<ticker>/<date>/<run id>/
acceptance: Every run writes the full set of files
An index file lists runs with their cost

features.title: Claim checker: match every number in the proposal and decision to the snapshot or analyst reports within a tolerance
acceptance: Unmatched numbers are listed in the run output
A seeded false figure is caught in a test

features.title: Grid runner over tickers and dates that skips completed cells and stops at the budget
acceptance: An interrupted grid resumes without rerunning finished cells
The budget stop leaves a clean partial result

features.title: Scoring: entry at the first close after the decision date, return over the holding period, alpha against the Nifty 50, grouped by rating
acceptance: Two cells match a hand calculation
Results are grouped by rating with hit rate and mean alpha

features.title: Parity report comparing our ratings with the TradingAgents baseline against its agreement band
acceptance: The report states the band, our agreement with TradingAgents and our own run-to-run agreement

features.title: Append each final decision to a memory log with ticker, date, rating, rationale and run id
acceptance: Every completed run adds one entry
A crashed run adds none

features.title: Settle decisions whose holding period has passed: realised return and alpha against the Nifty 50
acceptance: Settled values match a hand calculation for two cells
Unsettled decisions stay pending

features.title: Quick-tier reflection: one short paragraph per settled decision on what worked or did not
acceptance: Each settled entry gains a reflection
Reflections are cached for replay

features.title: Portfolio manager reads recent same-ticker decisions and lessons, using only entries settled before the run's as_of
acceptance: A decision settled after as_of is never shown to the portfolio manager

features.title: Ablation configs A to D as switches, run over the full fixture set twice each
acceptance: All four configs complete
Results include score, variance, claim-check failures, cost and latency

features.title: Evaluation report generator writing all results as Markdown tables with known limitations
acceptance: One command regenerates the full report from stored results with no model calls
